correctness.rationale: Direct reconstruction: conditional increment of A-count is +b with chance (1-p)a/(a+b), -a with chance (1-p)b/(a+b), and 0 on rewiring, so its conditional mean is zero and second moment is exactly (1-p)ab. The quadratic discordance potential X(N-X) has drift -(1-p)ab, with ab >= ell-1. Finite truncation gives E[min(t,tau)] <= i(N-i)/((1-p)(ell-1)), permitting monotone and bounded passage to the stopped exact budget. Restarting the uniform conditional mean bound and Markov inequality gives geometric tail. Every connected static pair graph achieves equality; a single size-ell hyperedge with one dissenter is sharp for the ell factor. verify.py independently passed 4888 exact rational assertions including finite topology-switching chains; finite checks do not replace the infinite-domain argument.

originality.rationale: The motivating complete article derives the group copying rule and first-moment magnetization conservation, but its source sections on magnetization, simulation and discussion do not derive a stopped quadratic discordance-exposure identity, an all-topology active-event count bound, or a geometric tail. The earlier hypergraph and simplicial papers use majority-like group influence; the pairwise adaptive consensus paper analyzes slow-manifold approximate time laws. Structural martingale methods are standard, not asserted new. Comparisons of statement and proof implications identified no direct covering result among the inspected materials; generic optional-stopping tools are acknowledged. Some priority uncertainty remains.
residual_risks: The bound follows from a classical martingale-variance mechanism; a specialist result phrased abstractly rather than as a hypergraph voter theorem may contain the exact conclusion.
Comparisons were limited to accessible primary source material, targeted literature retrieval and ranked mathematical research records; absence of a matching search hit does not prove priority.
The original source uses different event/physical-time normalization in some numerical plots; the claim states active-event and unit-rate-clock conventions explicitly.

value.rationale: The motivating literature observes a slow stochastic active phase in proportional polyadic opinion models but lacks a rigorous uniform work budget. The exact stopped variance identity gives a topology- and rewiring-independent ceiling on active interaction count and a geometric tail, even with fragmented terminal states. It provides a measurable exact account of cumulative discordant pair exposure and identifies the sharp minimal-group-size factor, with connected-graph equality showing the quadratic event-count order is not a loose artifact. The claim is a structural model-specific theorem, not a merely reparameterized finite example.
